name: How do I choose the right color temperature for under-cabinet lighting?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right color temperature for under-cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right color temperature depends on your kitchen's existing lighting and desired mood. Warm white (2700K-3000K) creates a cozy, inviting atmosphere, while cool white (4000K-5000K) offers brighter, more task-oriented illumination. Daylight (5000K-6500K) mimics natural light. A practical tradeoff to consider is balancing task lighting needs with the overall warmth of your kitchen; sometimes a dimmer with adjustable color temperature can offer the best of both worlds.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select color temperature based on desired mood: warm white for cozy, cool white for task lighting, and daylight for natural light mimicry.
